title: PepsiCo Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results; Updates Fiscal 2026 Guidance (earnings release, p.5)
snippet: Fiscal 2026 guidance, current vs previous: Core EPS +2.5% to +3.5% (previous: low-end of +5% to +7%); Core constant currency EPS +1% to +2% (previous: low-end of +4% to +6%); Organic revenue approximately +3% (previous: +2% to +4%); Net revenue approximately +6% (previous: +4% to +6%); Core annual effective tax rate approximately 21% (previous: approximately 22%).

title: PepsiCo Q3 2026 earnings release (SEC Form 8-K, Exhibit 99.1)
snippet: Net revenue increased 5.6 percent to $25,274 million; organic revenue increased 3.1 percent. Core EPS of $2.34 increased 2 percent. Core operating profit performance reflects productivity savings, effective net pricing and a 4-percentage-point favorable impact of tariff refunds.

title: PepsiCo Q3 2026 prepared management remarks (CFO commentary and outlook)
snippet: Tariff refunds amounted to $178 million in the third quarter. We expect North America's core operating margin performance to remain under pressure in the fourth quarter. We now expect organic revenue growth of approximately 3 percent, implying net revenue growth of approximately 6 percent; we are also moderating PepsiCo's core constant currency EPS growth outlook, which reflects the margin pressures we expect in the North America business.
